.claude-plugin/marketplace.json.summary: Plugin marketplace configuration file for better-base-tools project. Defines the plugin name, owner (Thore Höltig), version 1.2.0, and references two sub-plugins: batch_file_tools and project-intel-tool. Metadata describes purpose as more efficient base tools to reduce turns, duplicate tool calls and token usage.

.gitignore.summary: Standard git ignore configuration excluding common build artifacts, dependency directories, logs, cache directories, and IDE files. Covers typical Node.js, Python, and platform-specific patterns.

LICENSE.summary: MIT License file for the better-base-tools project. Copyright 2026 Thore Höltig. Grants free use, modification and distribution of the software with standard MIT terms.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.claude-plugin/.summary: Plugin manifest declaring batch_file_tools as a Claude Code MCP plugin. Defines version 1.4.0, author (Thore Höltig), description (batch file I/O reducing tool calls and context by 50-60%), license (MIT), homepage/repository URLs, and keywords for discoverability. No external dependencies declared.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for batch_file_tools. Registers the MCP server with command 'node' running the compiled index.js from plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/dist/. Minimal configuration pointing to the server entry point.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Comprehensive version history from 0.1.0 (first release) through 1.4.0 (2026-10-04). Documents breaking changes (searchTerm literal matching, line range headers), additions (searchRegex, offset/count support, path access control), fixes (multi-line searches, truncation, stale-read errors), and removals (fileinfo mode, indentation normalization). Each entry links to GitHub release tags.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/hooks.jso.summary: Hooks configuration registering two lifecycle hooks: SessionStart injects usage instructions via session-start.js, and PreToolUse matcher (Read|Edit|Write) fires pre-tool-use.js to nudge users toward batch tools instead of native file operations.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/pre-tool-.summary: Node.js hook script that intercepts native Read, Edit, Write tool calls. Drains stdin safely, then emits a reminder via additionalContext to prefer batch_read/batch_edit (which bundle N files/ops per call) and points users to deny native tools in permissions settings to stop the reminder. Never grants access the user did not approve.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/session-s.summary: Node.js session-start hook validating MCP build availability. Checks CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, verifies dist/index.js exists, returns JSON with instructions directing users to batch_read/batch_edit over native tools. Single 52-line file.

plugins/batch_file_tools/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for batch_file_tools plugin. Copyright 2026 Thore Höltig. Standard MIT terms allowing free use, modification, and distribution with liability disclaimer.

plugins/batch_file_tools/README.md.summary: Primary user and developer documentation for batch_file_tools MCP plugin. Explains efficiency gains (58% fewer tool calls, 46% less context) with session analysis data across three projects. Documents batch_read/batch_edit tools, modes, read/edit operations, configuration via env/args, path access control with allow/deny lists, requirements (Node >=20, SDK, zod), and recommended Claude Code setup.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/package.summary: npm lockfile pinning exact versions for reproducible builds: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0, zod 4.5.4, typescript 7.0.2, @types/node 24.13.3, plus 50+ transitive dependencies (express, cors, hono, ajv, etc.). Ensures all installations use identical dependency trees across environments.

npm package manifest for batch-tools-mcp-server v1.4.0 (MIT). Declares bin entry point (dist/index.js), build script (tsc), test suite with custom reporter, typecheck target, and MCP inspector. Requires Node >=20; depends on SDK 1.30.0 and zod 4.5.4 for validation. Author: Thore Höltig.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/ind.summary: MCP server entry point for batch file tools. Initializes batch_read and batch_edit tools, manages allowed directories via roots and include paths, handles authorization checks with elicitation, supports dry-run mode, configures output token budgets and logging, manages process lifecycle.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/lib.summary: In-memory edit buffer management for file operations. Loads and tracks file state (existed, exists, lines, endings), lazily reads content on demand, and provides write operations with parent directory creation. Handles ENOENT gracefully for new files.

Core edit operation executor applying replace, replace_all, insert_at_line, replace_range, append, and overwrite to file buffers in-place. Handles exact and whitespace-normalized fuzzy matching, generates error hints with nearest anchors using Levenshtein distance, maintains file state integrity.

Formatting layer converting ReadOutput and EditOutput into ToolContentResult blocks for MCP consumption. Handles output modes (assistant/user audience), error display with anchors and hints, content truncation with token budget management, and concise summarization of outcomes.

Utility module for extracting file references from code and markdown content. Uses regex patterns to identify imports, requires, markdown links, and path literals. Filters out non-file URLs and package names, returning a deduplicated sorted array of relative/absolute file references.

File system access layer providing safe read/write with authorization guards. Implements path resolution (symlink, home directory expansion), permission checking against allowed directories, detailed error mapping (ENOENT, EISDIR, EACCES), and support for excluded/approved paths.

File system globbing module using Node fs/promises API. Expands glob patterns and directory paths into sorted lists of absolute, symlink-resolved file paths. Detects glob syntax and checks if paths need expansion (directories or patterns).

Line-aware text processing module preserving exact byte boundaries and line endings. Provides split/join operations, CRLF vs LF detection, line ending conversion, and normalized string matching. Supports byte-exact round-tripping for mixed-ending files.

File search implementation with regex and literal term matching. Finds match ranges, applies context windows, handles multi-line searches, formats results with ripgrep-style line labels (N:, N-). Supports both single-line and whole-text pattern matching with case-insensitive searching.

Edit hint generation using Levenshtein distance for fuzzy matching. Finds nearest-similar lines when exact anchors fail, builds unique context windows around errors, and provides helpful suggestions for re-reading or widening anchors in edit operations.

Content formatting for read modes. Compact mode strips whitespace and collapses lines for non-indent-sensitive files; minifies JSON; preserves indentation for Python/YAML/Makefiles. Verbatim mode preserves byte exactness. Supports sliced reads with offset/limit pagination.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/too.summary: Core orchestrator for multi-file, multi-operation edits. Manages file planning with glob expansion and authorization, two-phase execution (line-addressed ops DESC by anchor, content ops in order), overlap detection between ranges, buffer loading/writing, and detailed error reporting with near-match hints.

Core batch read handler implementing request deduplication, glob expansion, file caching, regex-based search with context-block merging, and multiple read modes with formatting and offset/count pagination. Coalesces overlapping slices and mixed modes efficiently without redundant reads.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/typ.summary: Zod schema definitions for batch_read and batch_edit tools. Defines ReadMode, error reasons, ReadInput/Output with glob/search/slice support, EditOp discriminated union (replace/replace_all/insert_at_line/replace_range/write), FileError, OpStatus. Central types document anchoring contract for tool behavior and validation rules.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/a.summary: Test suite for authorization and excluded paths. Validates isAccessible predicate, rejects reads/edits outside allowed directories, blocks excluded files inside allowed dirs, allows approved paths to pierce exclusions, tests resolveExcludePaths anchoring relative patterns to base directories.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/e.summary: Test suite for stopOnError control flow. Covers file-level and op-level stopOnError flags overriding root-level behavior, cascade through operations and files, interaction with phase execution, dryRun mode preventing disk writes, output filtering to show only non-ok ops.

Test suite for whitespace-tolerant anchor matching in replace/replace_all. Validates space-indented anchors match tab files, 2-space matches 4-space, exact matches win, non-whitespace diffs refuse edits, multi-line blocks match across indent depths, single-line edits preserve surrounding indentation style.

Comprehensive test suite for handleBatchEdit, the core multi-file editor orchestrator. Tests write, insert_at_line, replace_range, replace, and replace_all operations; two-phase execution; line-ending auto-conversion (CRLF/LF); error handling with hints; overlap detection; and batch multi-file scenarios. Covers 30+ test cases including edge cases like ambiguous anchors, missing files, and abort-on-error behavior.

Test suite for output formatting covering read/edit result blocks, metadata headers, error display, truncation at token budget limits, line range encoding, search output formats, MCP content result generation, and audience annotations.

Tests file reference extraction from code (imports/requires/dynamic) and markdown links. Validates filtering of npm packages and node builtins, path normalization, deduplication, and regex patterns for both ES and CommonJS modules.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/g.summary: Test suite for glob expansion in replace_all and write(append). Validates directory/glob pattern matching, single-level vs recursive matching, incompatible op rejection (insert_at_line, replace_range, write(overwrite)), merge of concrete and glob-resolved paths, deduplication across multiple entry formats.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/h.summary: Lightweight test assertion helper mimicking Jest/Chai syntax. Provides matcher interface with toBe/toEqual/toContain/toHaveLength/toMatch and negation support. Wraps Node assert for compatibility with custom test runner.

Custom streaming test reporter for Node.js test runner producing compact, LLM-optimized output. Generates summary header with pass/fail counts, failing test names with file:line-col locations, inline source lines, and actual return values. Caches file reads for efficiency.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/l.summary: Tests line-aware text processing preserving exact line endings (CRLF/LF). Validates splitLines/joinLines byte-exactness for round-tripping mixed-ending files. Ensures line counting and normalization across different line ending formats.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/r.summary: Extensive test suite for batch read handler covering single/multi-file reads, search operations (literal and regex), context windows, compact/verbatim modes, glob expansion, folder reads, deduplication, offset/count pagination, error handling, multi-line searches, and CRLF preservation.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/s.summary: Test suite for fuzzy string matching and edit anchor generation. Validates Levenshtein distance algorithm for typo tolerance, findNearestLine() for locating similar lines in content, and buildNearestAnchor() for constructing unique context windows around errors. Covers edge cases: empty needles, file size limits, boundary conditions, duplicate patterns, CRLF preservation, and uniqueness validation for edit operations.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/t.summary: Comprehensive test suite for formatForRead function covering compact and verbatim modes. Tests whitespace stripping, blank line collapsing, indent preservation for Python/YAML/Makefile, JSON minification, CRLF handling, offset/limit pagination, and returned line count accuracy.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tsconfi.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration targeting ES2024 with strict mode, source maps, and declaration files. Configures module resolution for Node, output to dist/, and excludes tests and node_modules from main build.

Extended TypeScript configuration for test compilation. Extends base config, outputs to dist-tests/, includes both src/ and tests/ directories, enabling independent type-checking of test code alongside implementation.
TypeScript configuration for type checking. Extends main tsconfig, disables emit and declarations, includes src and tests, excludes dist and node_modules. Used for validation before build.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/vitest..summary: Vitest test runner configuration for batch_file_tools scripts. Runs tests from tests/**/*.test.ts files in Node.js environment. Minimal setup providing baseline for TypeScript unit and integration test execution.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.claude-plugi.summary: Plugin manifest for project-intel-tool v1.6.0. Declares metadata including name ('project-intel-tool'), description, version, author (Thore Höltig), homepage, repository, and license (MIT). Keywords list tokens, efficiency, development, reconnaissance, and semantic search.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for project-intel-tool. Registers project-intel-tool as MCP server executed via Node.js, pointing to compiled dist/index.js script in plugin root. Enables integration with Claude harness for tool invocation.

plugins/project-intel-tool/agents/projec.summary: Agent definition for batch file analysis subagent. Specifies haiku model, restricted tool access (Read, batch_read, submit_analysis), max 4 turns. Instructs agent to read batch file once, analyze files inline, call submit_analysis, and reply Done.

plugins/project-intel-tool/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Complete version history for project-intel-tool from 0.1.0 to 1.6.0 (Oct 2026). Tracks structural scan changes (git-based file detection, lock semantics, stale field cleanup), stop-hook refresh cycle, sub-knowledge aggregation, import/export schema evolution, and token-budget-aware batching.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/hooks.j.summary: Hook lifecycle configuration registering SessionStart and Stop hooks. SessionStart runs synchronously to check/initialize project knowledge; Stop runs asynchronously to refresh structural data after each turn. Both invoke run-script.js with event names for error propagation.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/run-scr.summary: Entry point runner for built hook scripts. Validates CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env var and script existence in dist/, provides actionable error messages if build is missing. Spawns script with inherited cwd/env/stdio, optionally formats errors as hook output (with event name) or sends to stderr.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/session.summary: Node.js hook script for SessionStart event. Validates CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable and checks if sessionstart-knowledge-check.js is built. Spawns the knowledge check subprocess and relays stdio/exit code. Provides actionable error if build is missing.

plugins/project-intel-tool/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for project-intel-tool. Grants rights to use, modify, distribute under conditions of attribution and liability disclaimer. Copyright holder is Thore Höltig (2026).

plugins/project-intel-tool/README.md.summary: Comprehensive documentation for the project-intel-tool MCP server. Explains the persistent knowledge base system that maintains structural (size, imports, exports, refs) and semantic (summary, role, technologies) metadata about project files. Details the query and scan tools, session start hook behaviour, two scan modes (subagent/sampling), configuration options, and cost comparisons showing ~35% cheaper orientation than exploration agents with 100% reduction in subagent token overhead.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/index.summary: MCP server entry point (v1.6.0) registering scan, query, and submit_analysis tools. Manages root directories, logging, progress notifications, CLI args. Implements both direct MCP sampling and fallback subagent workflow for batch analysis. Handles graceful shutdown on signals.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/a.summary: Helper module that prepares sampling batches by combining scan results with existing summaries. Calls buildFileMap and buildSamplingBatches to produce AI analysis workload.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/c.summary: Test suite for checkReadCapacity function validating configuration validation across diverse environment scenarios. Tests token/char cap conversion, env var fallbacks, maxResultSizeChars annotation handling, interaction between harness and server budgets, and advice generation for mismatched configurations.

Validates read capacity constraints between batch file sizes and system read tool limits (native Read, batch_read, MCP output tokens). Converts heterogeneous token/char-based limits to unified character units, detects mismatches where batch content would exceed any read path's capacity causing silent truncation, and provides diagnostic advice for configuration adjustments.

Unit tests for configuration parsing module (parseConfigArg, parseConfigArgRecord). Validates environment variable and CLI argument priority (env > argv > default), various argv formats (--key=value, --key value, bare flags), JSON object parsing with fallback behavior for invalid/non-object inputs, and edge cases (empty env vars, prefix confusion).

Configuration parsing utilities supporting env vars and CLI args with priority: env > argv > default. Exports parseConfigArg (single value), parseConfigArgRecord (JSON object), getIncludePaths, getExcludePaths, getHookScanConfig. Used consistently across hooks and server for flexible runtime configuration.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/f.summary: Comprehensive test suite for file parsing (parseFileRefs) and C# import resolution (resolveCSImports). Covers TypeScript/JavaScript static/dynamic imports, default/named/namespace specifiers, export extraction, external packages, C# using/type/member/const declarations, text/markdown references, ESM extension resolution, and cross-namespace import linking. 40+ test cases.

Core file analysis module parsing TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, and text files to extract imports, exports, and intra-project references. Handles static/dynamic imports, re-exports, namespace imports, ESM .js→.ts resolution, C# using directives, public/internal members, and markdown file links. Builds dependency graphs via buildFileMap and resolveCSImports.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/l.summary: Unit tests for lock.ts using Node.js test runner. Tests lock acquisition, release, staleness detection on dead/stale processes, corrupt lock grace period, max-age timeout expiry, and mid-wait lock release scenarios. Uses isolated temp directories per test.

File-based locking for coordinating concurrent analysis jobs. Implements acquireLock (atomic write with wx flag), releaseLock, acquireLockWithWait (timeout + retry loop). Detects stale locks via process.kill and 1-hour max age; grace period for corrupt locks to avoid mid-write false positives.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/p.summary: Unit tests for project-scanner.ts using Node.js test runner. Tests sub-knowledge discovery (boundaries, ignored directories, exclusions), file change detection, structural field cleanup on modified files, lock release, and lock rejection when held by live process.

Core scanning engine detecting new/modified/deleted files via git log or filesystem mtime. Builds dependency metadata and discovers nested .knowledge directories. Holds summaries lock across read-modify-write to prevent parallel overwrites. Computes analysis deltas, rebuilds structural fields (exports/imports/refs) on every scan.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/q.summary: Integration tests for query() recursive sub-knowledge aggregation. Tests nested aggregation via stored refs, aggregation from overrides when no top-level exists, cycle prevention, scope filtering across knowledge levels, and correct path prefixing in results.

Test suite for search scoring and output formatting (calculateConfidence, generateQueryOutput, outputToFluentText). Validates scoring logic for path/summary/exports/imports/searchTags/role/technologies matches, staleness penalties, flat/grouped output modes, verbosity levels (full/structure/semantic), folder aggregation, deduplication, and fluent text rendering with HTML comments.

Implements full-text search and ranking across file summaries with recursive sub-knowledge aggregation. Calculates confidence scores based on path, summary, exports, imports, technologies, and role. Supports grouped/flat output formats with multiple verbosity levels and semantic weighting based on file change delta.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/s.summary: Test suite for batching and context building (buildSamplingBatches). Validates file dependency ordering via topological sort, cohesion-based component clustering, circular dependency handling, context file inclusion from already-summarized deps, token budget enforcement across batches, and completeness (all files appear exactly once). 15+ test cases.

Batches files for AI analysis using token-budget-aware batching with topological and dependency sorting. Builds intra-scan dependency graphs, packs components into batches respecting token limits, manages sampling via MCP protocol or subagent workflow. Includes prompt generation with context, batch file writing, and integration with file-map for dependency resolution.

Test suite for summaries persistence (getOrCreateSummaries, writeSummaries, mergeSamplingResults, markFilesAsDeleted). Validates path normalization (./ and backslash prefixes), collision resolution (non-deleted over deleted, fresher timestamps), JSON round-tripping, sorted output for stable diffs, field preservation on updates, deleted flag lifecycle, and partial merges.

Manages persistence of file summaries to summaries.json. Provides getOrCreateSummaries (with path normalization), writeSummaries (minified JSON), mergeSamplingResults, and markFilesAsDeleted. Handles absolute/relative path conversions.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/packa.summary: Lock file pinning all dependencies for project-intel-mcp-server v1.6.0. Locks @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0 and zod 4.5.4 core deps; also pins extensive transitive dependencies for Express, Hono, HTTP utilities, and TypeScript tooling. Ensures reproducible builds and consistent dependency resolution across environments.

Manifest for project-intel-mcp-server v1.6.0 - an MCP server providing lightweight reconnaissance to query relevant files before blind exploration. Authored by Thore Höltig; includes scripts for build, test, type-check, and inspection. Minimal deps: SDK 1.30.0, Zod 4.5.4. Dev deps: TypeScript 7.0.2, Node types 24.13.3. Targets Node 20+.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/sessi.summary: Session start hook executable that detects new/modified/deleted files via git or mtime and maintains project knowledge status. Checks for existing knowledge directory, runs structural scan via scanProject, and outputs HookResponse with file summary counts, changed file counts, and unanalyzed file counts. Provides user guidance to use query tool and includes read capacity validation warnings. Handles both first-time setup and incremental scans.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/stop-.summary: Stop hook that silently refreshes structural data (imports, exports, file sizes) of changed files. Runs asynchronously after each turn without reporting to model; errors logged to stderr only. Ensures dependency graphs and metadata stay current between scans.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tests.summary: Vitest-compatible expect() wrapper around Node.js assert/strict for test assertions. Provides chainable matchers (toBe, toEqual, toContain, toHaveLength, toHaveProperty, toMatch, etc.) with not negation support. Handles ArrayContaining for partial array matching. Reduces test migration friction when switching from Vitest to Node.js test runner.

Custom Node test reporter that formats test output with counts (passed/skipped/failed) and detailed failure info. Parses test events, extracts source lines from stack traces, displays actual vs expected values. Used by test:watch and test scripts via --test-reporter flag.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tscon.summary: TypeScript configuration targeting ES2024 with NodeNext module resolution. Strict mode enabled with rigorous checks (noUnused*, noImplicit*, exact optional properties). Compiles lib/, index.ts, and session/structure files from root to dist/. Generates declaration files and source maps for debugging and type visibility.

TypeScript configuration extending tsconfig.json for test builds. Outputs compiled tests to dist-tests/ without declaration files. Includes lib/ directory for testing all library code. Enables separate test compilation pipeline independent from production build.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/types.summary: Central type definitions and constants for the project-intel system. Exports Zod-validated schemas for FileSummary, SummariesData, SamplingBatch, and MCP tool contracts. Defines enums for format/role/verbosity types, token budgets, environment variable names, configuration schemas, and output interfaces for queries and analysis submissions.

README.md.summary: Project overview for better-base-tools, a collection of Claude Code plugins reducing token usage and context overhead. Introduces batch_file_tools (batching reads/edits to cut 58% tool calls, 46% context) and project-intel-tool (persistent knowledge base for oriented exploration at near-zero cost vs 577k subagent tokens). Describes how tools work together: query orients without reading, batch tools execute changes efficiently. Includes author note on motivation for token efficiency over token-burning theatrics, installation instructions via marketplace, and comparative metrics against native tool workflows.
